body.p: In the Paper, at pg. 3, the Examiner proposes the following division of the claims into Groups:
In accordance with 37 CFR 1.499, applicant is required, in reply to this action, to
elect a single invention to which the claims must be restricted.
Group I, claim(s) 1-2 and 3-5, drawn to a method of assessing an impact of a test
Group II, claim(s) 6-14, drawn to a perfume composition.

The applicant TRAVERSES the Examiner's division of the claims, and believes that the lodged 'restriction requirement' is improper. The applicant contends that no additional or excess effort would be required in order to contemporaneously perform a concurrent search of the subject matter relevant to all claims presented in the Preliminary Amendment.

However in order to ensure completeness of this response, should the Examiner maintain the 'restriction requirement', the applicant provisionally elects the subject matter of the Group I claims, claims 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 for further action. The applicant also expressly reserves their right to seek rejoinder of any/all withdrawn claims upon indication of allowable subject matter and entry of suitable amendments to withdrawn claims.

At page 4, the Examiner notes an 'election of species' requirement. However in view of the fact that no 'species' is actually identified in the Paper, the applicant presumes that no such requirement had actually been lodged, and hence no response is necessitated.

Should the Examiner in charge of this application believe that telephonic communication with the undersigned would meaningfully advance the prosecution of this application, they are invited to call the undersigned at their earliest convenience.

Should any further fee be required by the Commissioner in order to permit the timely entry of this paper, including any extension of time fees, the Commissioner is authorized to charge any such required fee to Deposit Account No. 14-1263.
